# TopRankers

> TopRankers is India's premier online coaching platform offering comprehensive exam preparation for law, management, and design entrance exams through live classes, expert mentorship, and unlimited mock tests.

TopRankers provides specialized coaching programs through partner brands (LegalEdge, SuperGrads, Creative Edge, Judiciary Gold) covering major Indian entrance exams including CLAT, CAT, IPMAT, CUET, NATA, NID, and judicial exams. The platform combines live interactive classes, extensive study materials, and free practice tests to help students achieve top ranks.
